fact: AGETIC held a training workshop for ministries' communication officers on the gouv.ml government email, web and mobile versions, chaired by the minister.

AGEFAU financed the launch on 1 September 2026 of office-software and collaborative-tools training run by the Centre de Formation des Collectivités Territoriales for 504 elected officials and staff of 126 communes, whose first session drew 84 participants from 21 communes.
